as_told.title: JFK and LBJ visit Los Alamos weeks after Malmgren's briefing

plain: In 1962, President Kennedy is said to have gone to the Los Alamos nuclear laboratory in person, soon after a young Harold Malmgren had been briefed there. Michels says it came a month after Malmgren met a man named Lawrence Preston Gise, and he calls it "not really that normal" for Kennedy to come and check things himself. Pippa Malmgren, appearing on the show with Harold Malmgren, says it was "literally a couple of weeks later" and that LBJ and both men's teams came too. Both tell it as a hint that the president took a personal interest in whatever Malmgren had been shown.
